request.notes: roleTemplate is one of ADMIN | DEVELOPER | ACCOUNT_OFFICER (frontend-defined presets, apps/web mapped these to real POST /api/v1/roles calls with specific permissionNames - see packages/schemas/src/onboarding.ts ROLE_TEMPLATE_META). A real backend implementation could keep these as presets or accept an arbitrary roleId instead.

biggestGap: There is no 'join an existing business' signup path on the backend (POST /api/v1/auth/signup always creates a brand-new business or a plain individual). A real invitation flow needs a second signup variant, e.g. POST /api/v1/auth/signup/accept-invite { token, firstName, lastName, phoneNo, password } that attaches the new user to the inviting business_id with the invite's role - see apps/web/src/app/api/onboarding/invites/accept/route.ts's comment for where the frontend currently stops short.
notificationGap: FR-Notif-1: sending the invite email itself isn't wired up anywhere yet - the frontend just displays inviteUrl for the business owner to copy/share manually.
